'''Quorr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on [[Voss]].
